title: Pixel Parade
description: Send colored carts around a conveyor belt to blast matching pixels off five original pixel pictures without jamming the five-cart belt.
controls: Tap a cart at the front of a lane to send it onto the belt. Carts shoot the first pixel of their color they can see; empty carts leave. Five stuck carts jam the belt.

zh-CN.title: 像素巡游
zh-CN.description: 把彩色小车送上环形传送带，打掉同色像素清空五幅原创像素画，别让 5 辆车堵死传送带。
zh-CN.controls: 点队列最前面的小车送上传送带，它会射击视线里第一个同色像素，弹药打完自动离开；5 辆车都打不到就失败。
